{"metadata":{"description":"Model-agnostic Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: isolated browser, Windows native helper, third-party vision perception, and a Chrome Cookie Bridge.","id":"gh:1333965552","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-computer-use","slug":"xiaoheizi1212/dsh-computer-use","topics":["computer-use","computer-use-agent","dsh-plugin","playwright","vision","windows-automation"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Model-agnostic Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: isolated browser, Windows native helper, third-par"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ty vision perception, and a Chrome Cookie Bridge."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-computer-use"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Model-agnostic Computer Use capability for DeepSeek Harness: an isolated browser, a Windows native h"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"elper, provider-neutral observation, a Chrome **Cookie Bridge** for importing your logged-in session"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"s, and a text planner (DeepSeek) plus a third-party vision model for perception."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Platform & License"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **License**: MIT — open source, free to use, modify, and redistribute.
- **Platform**: the `window"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s` provider's native helper is **Windows-only**; the `playwright` browser provider and everything el"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"se are cross-platform.
- **macOS**: not currently developed — the author has no macOS environment. *"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"*Developers are welcome to contribute a macOS version.**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Credits"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**1st version** — created using **DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813** with **DeepSeek Harness**."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Token usage: **223,443,625** tokens · **99% cache hit rate**."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it provides"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- A capability seam `ctx.computerUse` (`start` / `listTargets` / `observe` / `act` / `stop`).

- Three providers behind one seam: `fake` (deterministic tests), "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"`playwright` (isolated Chromium), `windows` (native helper).
- A perception layer: `accessibility` m"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ode (no image) and `analyze` mode (screenshot → third-party vision model → structured result).
- Ris"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"k-classified, fail-closed approval + domain allowlist + a full `computer/*` replayable session log."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Required plugins (harness dependencies)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Package | Why |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` | Hosts the third-party **vision route** (declares `input:['text','im"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"age']`) |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` | The `image` content block and `createUserMessage` |
| `@deepsee"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"k-ai/dsh-attachment` (+ `-local`) | Persists screenshots as content-addressed refs |
| `@deepseek-ai"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"/dsh-credentials` (+ `-local`) | Resolves the vision API key per request |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"approval` | One-shot fail-closed action approval |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `-session` / `-syste"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"m-prompt` | Tool registry, session log, guidance |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` is text-only and **cannot** be the vision model — it is the planner."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"All options live on the `dsh-computer-use/plugin` row (`config:`), for example in your profile's `co"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" on the `dsh-computer-use/plugin` row (`config:`), for example in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> You can also flip the whole capability on/off **live from the DeepSeek Harness GUI** — the plugin "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"registers a `computer-use` settings section (Settings → `computer-use`), so `enabled`, `provider`, a"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"nd the browser/import options above are editable without editing YAML."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Core"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Option | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `enabled` | `true` | Master toggle — `false` turns the whole capability off |
| `provider` | `fake"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"` | Backend: `fake` (tests) \| `playwright` (browser) \| `windows` (desktop) |
| `tools` | `true` | "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"Register the model-facing tools |
| `confirmActions` | `true` | One-shot confirmation before risky `"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"computer_act` calls |
| `visionProvider` / `visionModel` | — | llm-pi-ai route + model used by `comp"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"uter_perceive analyze` |

| `allowedDomains`"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" | `[]` | Hostnames the browser may act inside (empty = no restriction) |

To give it your logged-in state:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**A. Cookie Bridge (recommended — works with Chrome 127+ App-Bound Encryption)**"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Chrome 127+ encrypts cookies with App-Bound Encryption, so a separate process cannot read your exist"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ing profile's cookies. The Cookie Bridge sidesteps this by running **inside Chrome**: a small extens"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ion reads cookies via `chrome.cookies` (plaintext — Chrome decrypts them itself) and POSTs them to a"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"s via `chrome.cookies` (plaintext — Chrome decrypts them itself) and POSTs them to a local receiver."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Then point the plugin at the saved `cookies.json`:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"> Cookie values only travel from Chrome to `127.0.0.1` (never to a remote host), and only the cookie"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"s for the domains you pick are exported. Multiple exports merge (deduped by domain|path|name)."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"**B. Dedicated browser profile (log in once manually)**"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Use a plugin-owned, **non-default** profile. Chrome refuses remote debugging on its real `User Data`"},{"id":"p37s2","text":" dir, and copying a profile does not carry App-Bound cookies, so the supported path is a fresh dedic"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"ated profile where you log in once:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
